waivers.verdict: Claim Joe Milton for $6 to block amandaberry's bye-week QB fix; drop Juwan Johnson to make room. Everything else — kicker, defense, the four trending names — holds.

lineup.verdict: Gesicki in for Kraft at TE (bye) and Warren in for Washington at FLEX — both an easy call on the numbers. Keep Goff at QB; start Young over Cousins at SUPER_FLEX on the matchup.

trades.verdict: Hold. Withdraw both open offers (Young for Swift, Young for St. Brown). Playoffs are single elimination, and each costs you points in Week 15 on matchups, when Goff draws Minnesota and Lamar likely isn't back. The one deal that helps in every playoff week, Young for Jaxon Smith-Njigba, costs 1–2 points this week, so the card can't carry it.

inactives.verdict: Nobody new is Out or Doubtful. But Goff's early Munich kickoff already passed, which locks Thursday's planned QB swap out of the QB slot for good — it has to land at SUPER_FLEX instead, starting Young over Cousins. Irving (bye) for Warren at RB and Gesicki for Washington at FLEX are unchanged from Thursday and still open — make all three before the 1pm kickoffs.

actions.name: Joe Milton
actions.why: amandaberry (this week's opponent) has Jordan Love on bye and $90 FAAB; Milton is their cheapest fix and the denial model's bid estimate is about $6.

actions.name: Mike Gesicki
actions.why: Kraft is on bye. Gesicki's matchup is the better of the two bench tight ends — Washington gives up the 2nd-most fantasy points to TEs in the league.

case.starts: Mike Gesicki in at TE, Tucker Kraft to the bench
case.need: Tucker Kraft: healthy, GB bye W11

actions.name: Jaylen Warren
actions.why: Warren projects higher and grades higher on the matchup; Washington's Miami offense is down to its third different QB (McCord) this season.

case.starts: Jaylen Warren in at FLEX, Malik Washington to the bench
case.need: Malik Washington: healthy, MIA bye W6

actions.name: Bryce Young
actions.why: QBs are bunched on projection, but SF is the stingiest of the three matchups. Holds only if the open Young-for-Swift trade offer doesn't process first.

case.starts: Bryce Young in at SUPERFLEX, Kirk Cousins to the bench
case.need: Kirk Cousins: healthy, MIN bye W6
